value.clickHint: Click a row to see the sampled entries and the judge's reasons
value.rule: Each weekday a judge that took no part in writing them scores a sample of new entries in each destination, by what that destination is for: useful, weak or withdraw. The line in each bar is the target. The judge only scores; it removes nothing. It judges each entry as written, for where it is: whether the writer checked the code or researched enough is the writer's job, not the judge's.

value.samplesHint: Set your own verdict on an entry: it replaces the judge's in the rates and shows how far to trust the judge.

step.capturedRule: An agent that was there writes down what is worth keeping.
step.basicRule: Empty text or a link carrying a password is dropped. Nothing about meaning is judged here.
step.placeRule: What it is (lesson, gap, event, reference) and who it is about (you, the agent, the world, a project) pick the file and section.
step.trustRule: Files read every turn take only your own words or a measurement. Anything else goes to a brain that is recalled on demand.
step.compareRule: The agent that wrote it says whether it is new, adds to an entry, or is the same as one.
step.writtenRule: Saved with its sources and its link to the entry it adds to.
